marketAnalysis.summary:
# Korean Market Analysis (2026-08-11)
**KOSPI Performance & Regional Context:** KOSPI stands at 6,345.53, tracking alongside a flat U.S. market (SPX 7,753.11) amid moderate volatility [^VIX:15.49]. The market regime reflects cautious positioning as investors digest inflation data (CPI 3.5%, June 2026) and employment headwinds (NFP -23k, July 2026).
**Risk Drivers & Sentiment:** Oil prices (WTI $83.49/barrel) pressured equity momentum following Iran geopolitical tensions affecting Strait of Hormuz reopening prospects, while gold ($4,438.7/oz) strengthened on inflation-risk concerns. Fear & Greed sits at 65 (neutral-to-greedy), indicating tempered optimism. The 10Y yield (4.699%) and strong dollar (DXY 99.862) signal persistent rate expectations under Fed policy (3.63%).
**Watch Items:** Tech earnings resilience (NVIDIA Q1 FY2027 growth), corporate profitability strain (Riot Platforms Q2 2026 loss), and ongoing geopolitical supply-chain risks remain critical near-term catalysts for Korean export-dependent equities.
